'''Théo Maledon''' (born 12 June 2001) is a French professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[ASVEL Basket|ASVEL]] of the [[LNB Pro A]]. He plays the [[point guard]] position.

Born in [[Rouen]], Maledon played youth basketball for French sports institute [[INSEP]] before joining the youth ranks of ASVEL at age 16. One year later, at the senior level, he became the youngest [[LNB All-Star Game|LNB All-Star]] in history and won the [[LNB Pro A Best Young Player]] award. He helped ASVEL win Pro A and [[French Basketball Cup|French Cup]] titles, while being named [[French Basketball Cup Final MVP|French Cup Final Most Valuable Player]] (MVP).

At the youth international level, Maledon won a gold medal with [[France men's national under-17 basketball team|France]] at the [[2016 FIBA U16 European Championship]] and a silver medal at the [[2018 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|2018 FIBA Under-17 World Cup]]. He has also played for the [[France national basketball team|senior national team]].

== National team career ==
=== French junior national team ===
Maledon made his youth debut for [[France men's national under-17 basketball team|France]] at the [[2016 FIBA U16 European Championship|2016 FIBA Under-16 European Championship]] in [[Radom]], Poland. === French senior national team ===
On 24 February 2019, Maledon debuted for the [[France men's national basketball team|French senior national team]] during the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)|2019 FIBA World Cup qualification]] stage. He played 15 minutes, recording three points and three rebounds, in a 76–69 loss to [[Finland men's national basketball team|Finland]].<ref name="finland">{{cite web |title=French teen phenom Theo Maledon debuts as millennials shine |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2019/european-qualifiers/news/french-teen-phenom-theo-maledon-debuts-as-millennials-shine |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=29 July 2019 |date=22 February 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190729181259/http://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2019/european-qualifiers/news/french-teen-phenom-theo-maledon-debuts-as-millennials-shine |archive-date=29 July 2019 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 7 August, Maledon scored 14 points, making four of five field goal attempts, in a 94–56 victory over [[Tunisia men's national basketball team|Tunisia]] in preparation for the World Cup.<ref name="tunisia">{{cite web |last1=Djordjevic |first1=Stefan |title=Fournier, Maledon lead France to convincing win over Tunisia |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fibawc/916781/fournier-maledon-lead-france-to-convincing-win-over-tunisia/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=30 April 2020 |date=7 August 2019}}</ref> He was among the final cuts from France's World Cup roster, in part due to a shoulder injury.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Djordjevic |first1=Stefan |title=France presents the final World Cup squad |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fibawc/924515/france-announces-the-world-cup-squad/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=30 April 2020 |date=27 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200226195930/https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fibawc/924515/france-announces-the-world-cup-squad/ |archive-date=26 February 2020 |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Both of Maledon's parents played basketball: his mother, Sylvie, with the French junior national team, and his father, Claude, in the NM1.<ref name="episode">{{cite web |last1=Pantel-Jouve |first1=Gabriel |title=Théo Malédon, the Next Episode |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-equipe-de-france/theo-maledon--the-next-episode.html |publisher=BeBasket |accessdate=26 December 2018 |language=French |date=9 February 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181010011159/https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-equipe-de-france/theo-maledon--the-next-episode.html |archive-date=10 October 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref> His uncle, Dominique Guéret, was an assistant coach for [[LNB Pro B]] club [[ALM Évreux Basket|ALM Évreux]], and his older sister, Lena, plays [[college basketball]] in the United States.<ref name=parisien/><ref name=episode/>
